patch_description:
Replace the current-state greedy decision with a projected post-placement KVPR decision: a GPU is selected based on the KVPR it will have after receiving the model, rather than its KVPR before placement. This directly matches the objective.

After constructing the feasible initial placement, perform strict-improvement local search. The search considers both moving a model away from a current bottleneck GPU and swapping a bottleneck model with a model on another GPU. Each accepted operation must reduce the global maximum KVPR while preserving memory feasibility. Swaps are important because a beneficial rebalance can require exchanging memory footprints when neither model can be moved directly.
